name: DuelArena
source: Example greybox spec for a knockback arena game with wall-running movement. It is also the baseline for scripts/verify_map.py, so keep its parts and ids as they are.
note: One square deck, one block in the middle, four shelves under the edge, three things in the sky. Every element services exactly one movement tech.
ground_is_parts: A floating sky arena: the deck is a platform over open void whose flat top and 12-stud side faces ARE the movement design (slide lane, wall-ride faces, ring-out edge). There is no ground for terrain to be.

volume.note: killPlane and ringOutOffset as first designed. The game fires the ring-out at killPlane + ringOutOffset. P9 fails this on purpose: run the prover and read its FIX line.

parts.note: 12 thick so the side faces are a real wall-ride surface, not a lip
26 tall = unjumpable. Three clean faces for wall-ride; the fourth has the ramp
The one boring way up the Core, on the -Z face only
Slung under each deck edge, tucked 5 studs in and jutting 21 out. Invisible from the deck
Three jobs: signpost above deck level, wall-ride ladder off a Ledge, and the grapple save
36 studs above the Core top. No jump chain reaches it
Pads past two opposite deck corners, over open void

intent.transitNote: A Post is a signpost, a wall-ride ladder and a grapple anchor. Its 4x4 top is not a destination, so it is exempt from the floor test.

ringOut.note: A player punted off an edge must have time to ragdoll-recover, turn, find an anchor and fire. minWindow is the CONTROL time needed after ragdoll ends.

sightlines.note: Too low and the map is a maze with no duels; too high and there is no cover and the sniper owns everything from spawn.
